_meta.description: Own record types (REQ-CRT-001..003): schemas an administrator added to the shillinq register in Open Register, chosen in the admin settings, each with a list and a detail page driven by the schema in the route.

adminTab._note: Board ShInstellingen, tab Eigen gegevens: one switch per schema of the shillinq register that the app did not ship. A switch writes through PATCH /api/custom-record-types (admin only), which refuses a shipped or unknown slug.

content.emptyText: No own record types yet. Add a schema to the shillinq register in Open Register first.

pages.title: Own records
pages._note: One card per shown own record type, read from GET /api/custom-record-types, and the empty state when none is shown or a typed URL named a type that is not shown (the router guard in src/utils/customRecordGuard.js sends such a URL here). Custom because the cards come from a server list rather than from fixed menu children.
